tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel Xeon E5-2699 v4 is a premium, high-performance 22-core server processor designed for enterprise-grade servers, virtualization platforms, cloud computing, and heavy multi-threaded workloads. With a massive 55MB cache, support for DDR4 memory, and robust Broadwell-EP architecture, it ensures reliable performance, scalability, and efficiency for demanding server deployments in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Base Clock Speed: 2.20 GHz
  • Max Turbo Frequency: Up to 3.60 GHz
  • Cores / Threads: 22 Cores / 44 Threads
  • Smart Cache: 55MB L3 Cache
  • Socket: LGA 2011-3 (FCLGA2011-3)
  • TDP: 145W
  • Architecture: 14nm Broadwell-EP
  • Memory Support: DDR4 up to 2400 MHz
  • PCIe: PCIe 3.0 support for high I/O performance
